text:
maria: Finance flagged a ~3.2x egress spike for the last billing period, most of it tagged as S3 data transfer us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. They attached CostExplorer graph and said it looks tied to snapshot restores. Any quick thoughts? :eyes:

billing-bot: automated alert: egress-data-transfer anomaly detected. period: 2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-08. delta = +1.9 TB. related resources: arn:aws:s3:::models-prod-artifacts, arn:aws:s3:::model-snapshots. link: https://billing.example.com/alerts/ALRT-9876

chris: can someone pull S3 access logs + CE query? quick CE snippet: 
```
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-03-01,End=2026-03-08 --granularity DAILY --metrics UnblendedCost --filter '{"Dimensions":{"Key":"USAGE_TYPE_GROUP","Values":["DataTransfer-Out-Bytes"]}}'
```

ash: I grepped the model-loader logs and see a restore job that runs every night. looks like an env var misconfig: RESTORE_REGION=eu-west-1 (should be us-east-1). small snippet from k8s crondeploy:
```
# k8s cron: model-warmup
schedule: "0 3 * * *"
env:
  - name: RESTORE_REGION
    value: "eu-west-1"  # <<< wrong
```

leo: found S3 server access log lines with large PUTs into eu-west-1 bucket around 2026-03-03 03:12:23 UTC. sample line (redacted):
```
2026-03-03T03:12:23Z us-east-1 54.123.45.67 RESTORE_JOB PUT models-prod-artifacts/eval-snapshot-20260303.tar.gz 1234567890 200 -
```

maria: oof. who owns that cron? @ash? can we pause it while we investigate? :hammer:

ash: yup, that is from model-warmup. pausing now. command: `kubectl patch cronjob model-warmup -p '{"spec": {"suspend": true}}'` — patched, job suspended.

chris: good. I'm also adding a temporary bucket policy to deny PutObject with x-amz-copy-source header when x-region != origin. quick policy applied to models-prod-artifacts. will share after tests.

billing-bot: support case opened with cloud provider for data transfer review: CASE-20260308-54321. attaching preliminary logs.

ash: root cause summary (short): nightly warmup cron was configured to restore archived snapshots into eu-west-1 for warm caches. restores pulled ~2TB of archived objects across regions (S3->S3 cross-region egress) instead of doing intra-region restore.

chris: action items: 1) keep cron suspended, 2) roll incorrect env change into config repo and add CI lint to prevent non-origin-region restores, 3) apply bucket policy to prevent cross-region writes, 4) hand-off logs/timestamps to finance for refund request.

finance: finance here — thanks. please export a list of object keys + timestamps + bytes transferred, and the source/destination regions. I opened a refund request with provider and they asked for CSV with those columns.

leo: I exported S3 access logs for 2026-03-02..2026-03-04 and generated a CSV with key,timestamp,size,src_region,dst_region. uploaded to secure share: https://files.example.com/snapshots-egress-20260303.csv

maria: next preventative: add a lifecycle/lazily-warm pattern that restores objects to the same region, or use a manifest-driven pre-warm that pulls small subsets. also add cost guardrail alert for >250GB cross-region restore/day.

ash: implemented quick bucket policy to deny cross-region PUTs and added a terraform change to set RESTORE_REGION default to ${var.region} in the chart. also added a lint rule to our deploy pipeline. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/model-loader/pull/428

chris: estimates: cloud provider shows potential credit for some of the transfer. finance please follow up with CASE-20260308-54321, reference the CSV.

finance: will do. I've filed refund request and tagged billing ops. need a brief note for executives summarizing impact and remediation (one-paragraph).

maria: I'll draft the exec one-pager and post to #all-hands after approval. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: alert resolved (jobs suspended, bucket policy added, refund request submitted). monitoring for repeat activity for 72h.

chris: leaving a postmortem stub in /docs/incidents/storage-egress-2026-03.md — we'll fill timeline and RCA tomorrow.

ash: follow-ups: add egress quota alerts, block cross-region restores by default, and add tagging requirement so finance can filter restores in CE.

maria: closing thread for now, will re-open if billing shows recurrence. great catch, team. :tada:
